title: Report On The Arrest Of S. Watanabe And B. Esaki,

page_data.en:
File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. G. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. ... 178 ...
Date May 2nd 29. 19 29）

REPORT

Subject (in full) The arrest of S. Watanabe and B. Esaki, blackmailers, by Hyogo
Police.

Made by J.D.I. Nakagawa. Forwarded by

Sir,

With reference to an article appearing in the Osaka Mainichi
of April 12, 1929, I beg to report acting under your instructions
that Chikaichi Watanabe (37) and Bunshiro Esaki (35), formerly
sailors aboard the Japanese freighter S.S. "Saisho Maru" of the
Yamamoto Kisen Kaisha, Sannomiya, Kobe, Japan, irregularly calling
at this port with shipment of cargoes, are unknown to either to
the members of the C.I.D. or the Japanese Consular Police.

Mr. S. Tajima, Chief of the Judicial Department of the local
Japanese Consulate, has informed me that nothing is known in
Shanghai about these blackmailers as he has no records of them
and that no information has been obtained from the Hyogo Police
with regard to their activities in Shanghai.

So far no traces of their smuggling any contraband goods to
Shanghai could be found by us or by the Consular Police officials,
although thorough enquiries have been made.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
S. Nakagawa.
J.D.I.

A.C. (Political) a/p.b.l
Information GRS 3/5/29

上海公共租界工部局警务处
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
编号 I. O. D. ... 178 ...
日期 1929年5月2日）

报告

事由（全称） 兵库县警察逮捕勒索犯 S. Watanabe 和 B. Esaki。

呈报人：J.D.I. Nakagawa。转呈人

阁下，

关于1929年4月12日《大阪每日新闻》刊登的一篇文章，谨遵照阁下的指示报告如下：渡边千吉（Chikaichi Watanabe，37岁）和江崎文四郎（Bunshiro Esaki，35岁），此前曾是日本神户三宫山本汽船株式会社（Yamamoto Kisen Kaisha）所属货轮“最上丸”号（S.S. "Saisho Maru"）上的船员，该轮不定期停靠本港装卸货物。刑事侦缉处成员及日本领事馆警察均不认识此二人。

当地日本领事馆司法部主任 Tajima 先生告知我，上海方面对这两名勒索犯一无所知，因为他处并无他们的记录，且从兵库县警察方面也未获得有关他们在上海活动的情报。

尽管已进行彻底查问，但我们及领事馆警察官员迄今均未发现他们向上海走私任何违禁品的踪迹。

此致，
敬礼
S. Nakagawa
日本侦探调查员（J.D.I.）

政治科助理专员 a/p.b.l
情报组 1929年5月3日

Form F
G. 2200c

THE OSAKA MAINICHI & THE TOKYO NICHI NICHI, OSAKA, FRIDAY, APRIL 12, 1929

Men Try to Blackmail
Revolver Smugglers

Whole Gang Is Arrested by
Hyogo Police

"Revolvers on sale in this house."
"Agent for revolvers." "Let's fight
it out!" Signs to the foregoing ef-
fect were put up day after day
at the lodgings of Shikichi Wata-
nabe and Bunshiro Esaki, formerly
sailors of the Yamashita Kisen
Shanghai liner □□□ at the
Minamiya public bath house, at
Higashi-Kawasaki-machi, Kobe city,
with the object of blackmailing
these men.

Having known a number of smug-
glers of various articles who they
were on the Shanghai run, Wata-
nabe and Esaki decided to start a
new business of blackmailing these
smugglers to get easy money some
time ago, and they succeeded at
snatching 80 revolvers valued at
¥3,000 on the street of Gochome,
Higashi-Kawasaki-machi, on the
night of March 10, this year, from a
regular revolver smuggler Kataro
Obayashi when he was together with
his wife transporting them in a
wooden box to one of his comrades,
Fujimoto.

Watanabe and Esaki stopped
them on the street, and announcing
themselves as detectives of the Aioi
police station, and managed to get
away with the wooden box contain-
ing the revolvers. Obayashi and his
wife realized soon afterwards that
they were robbed of their property
and told of their loss to Minato Iwa-
hashi and Isamu Yoshida, other
men of their comrades. It dawned
upon the last mentioned men that
the robbery must have been done
by the foregoing Watanabe and
Esaki and they searched for their
lodgings, and upon discovery, they
started intimidating them.

Meanwhile, Iwahashi and Yoshida
closely watched the movement of
Watanabe and Esaki so that the lat-
ter were unable to go out of doors,
until the Hyogo Prefectural police
arrested what was going on among
them and effected a wholesale
round-up of all.

Seven persons involved in this case
of smuggling, blackmailing, and
counter intimidation are now under
the police examination. It is now
learned that Watanabe and Esaki
have pocketed about ¥10,000 worth
of revolvers and bullets which they
extorted by means of similar tactics.

（批：III From Nakagawa
Dowei Kuwa
them 29/4）

A.R. 29 4/29）

G. 2200c

《大阪每日新闻》及《东京日日新闻》，大阪，1929年4月12日，星期五

男子企图勒索
左轮手枪走私贩

整个团伙被
兵库县警察逮捕

“本宅出售左轮手枪。”
“左轮手枪代理。” “咱们拼个你死我活！” 此类内容的招牌日复一日地挂在位于神户市东川崎町南屋公共浴室的渡边志吉（Shikichi Watanabe）和江崎文四郎（Bunshiro Esaki）的住处，此二人原为山下汽船上海航线轮船 □□□ 的船员，此举旨在勒索这些人。

渡边和江崎此前认识了数名在上海航线上从事各类物品走私的走私贩，于是决定开展一项新业务，即勒索这些走私贩以轻松获利。今年3月10日晚，他们在东川崎町五丁目街头，从一名常规左轮手枪走私贩大林片太郎（Kataro Obayashi）手中抢走了价值3,000日元的80支左轮手枪。当时大林正与其妻子一起将这些手枪装在木箱中运送给其同伙藤本（Fujimoto）。

渡边和江崎在街上拦住他们，自称是相生（Aioi）警察局的侦探，并设法带走了装有左轮手枪的木箱。大林及其妻子随后很快意识到财物被抢，便将损失告知了他们的其他同伙岩桥港（Minato Iwahashi）和吉田勇（Isamu Yoshida）。后两人想到抢劫者必是上述的渡边和江崎，于是搜寻他们的住处，找到后便开始恐吓他们。

与此同时，岩桥和吉田密切监视渡边和江崎的行动，致使后者无法出门，直到兵库县警察介入调查他们之间的勾当，并将所有人一网打尽。

涉及这起走私、勒索及反恐吓案件的七人目前正接受警方审讯。现已获悉，渡边和江崎通过类似手段勒索所得的左轮手枪和子弹，价值约10,000日元，已被他们装入囊中。
